color.rationale: Exact paints recur in component sheets and screens.

semantic.rationale: Roles inferred from repeated placement and state rows; names were not preserved by SVG.

space.rationale: Conservative 4px multiples supported by the spacing sheet and repeated geometry; incidental dimensions excluded.

radius.rationale: Repeated component corner families; pill is a CSS implementation decision for half-height radii.

border.rationale: 1px control outlines and dominant 1.5px icon strokes have different roles.

opacity.rationale: Observed values exist but intended semantic roles are not explicit.

shadow.rationale: Repeated SVG drop shadow: y=1, blur radius=3, #253D98 at 5%.

control.rationale: 32px and 40px control heights appear in explicit component sheets.

typography.rationale: Most text is outlined; no canonical family, weight, size scale, or line height is emitted.
